{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 64 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 6 && W == 64) begin : fast64
        wire [7:0] group_valid;
        wire [7:0] group_enable;
        wire [7:0] group_winner;
        wire [7:0] local_winner [0:7];
        wire [2:0] local_code [0:7];
        wire [7:0] code_terms [0:2];
        genvar g, j, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 8; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [7:0] x;
            assign x = input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 7) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[7:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 7) begin : top_position
                    assign local_winner[g][j] = x[j];
                end else begin : lower_position
                    assign local_winner[g][j] = x[j] & ~(|x[7:j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = ~(|input_unencoded[63:1]);
                end else begin : normal_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = local_winner[g][j] & group_enable[g];
                end
            end

            assign local_code[g][0] = |(local_winner[g] & 8'b10101010);
            assign local_code[g][1] = |(local_winner[g] & 8'b11001100);
            assign local_code[g][2] = |(local_winner[g] & 8'b11110000);
            for (b = 0; b < 3; b = b + 1) begin : code_gating
                assign code_terms[b][g] = local_code[g][b] & group_enable[g];
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_encoded[0] = |code_terms[0];
        assign output_encoded[1] = |code_terms[1];
        assign output_encoded[2] = |code_terms[2];
        assign output_encoded[3] = |(group_winner & 8'b10101010);
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_winner & 8'b11001100);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_winner & 8'b11110000);
    end else begin : generic_encoder
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_first
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb_first
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_first
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb_first
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths terminate at output_unencoded after priority selection and binary-to-one-hot decoding. This encode-then-decode dependency adds logic depth and loads shared encoded/control signals.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the fixed 64-bit MSB-priority configuration into eight parallel eight-bit groups. Compute local winners and higher-group exclusion concurrently, and form one-hot outputs directly without decoding output_encoded. Construct the binary output separately from local encoded results and group winners. Retain the original tree for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Direct one-hot generation should shorten the reported critical paths and reduce maximum arrival relative to 1.73 ns. A reasonable unverified target is approximately 1.3–1.6 ns; actual gain requires the specified mapping, STA, and electrical checks.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel local winner and group-exclusion logic while removing the specialized configuration's binary-to-one-hot decoder. Shared group reductions limit replication. Area is expected to remain within the 1713.518400 um2 cap, but no mapped area or electrical result is claimed.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Pure combinational logic with unchanged module, ports, parameter declarations, and output widths. For the specialized configuration, the highest asserted input wins. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=64'b1, matching the reference rather than suppressing the default one-hot output. All binary input combinations are supported without assumptions. Other parameter configurations retain the reference implementation, including its priority, padding, and truncation behavior. No state, latency, helper modules, or undefined outputs are introduced."
}
